name: npi-masking-regex
description:
Masks banking Nonpublic Personal Information (NPI) in LLM requests and restores it in LLM responses.
Values are found by the JSON key that holds them, by a verifiable format (IBAN, card number, E.164 phone, email), or by the label in front of them in text.
Only the value is replaced, so a placeholder the LLM copies into a tool call is restored to the real value before the agent sees it.
